{{Quote|You, Ori Garran! You sent your son to the scholars because he wasn't any good at the mill.|Adari Vaal, during her hearing before the Neshtovar|<ref name="Skyborn" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''son''' of the individual [[Ori Garran]]. Garran sent their son, whose work at a mill they deemed dissatisfactory, to learn from scholars including [[Geology|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]]. The male learnt of several theories which contradicted the Keshiri [[Keshiri religion|beliefs]] from the academics. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Vaal reminded the Keshiri's parent of why they had sent their son to the scholars during her hearing before the<ref name="Skyborn" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kesh system/Legends|Kesh system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] ruling council, the [[Neshtovar]].<ref name="Skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garran's son was mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', the second installment of Miller's ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith]]'' series.<ref name="Skyborn" />
